name: How can I ensure my rental renovation is durable and low-maintenance?

mainEntity.name: How can I ensure my rental renovation is durable and low-maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: To ensure your rental renovation is durable and low-maintenance, focus on selecting robust, high-quality materials designed for longevity and frequent use. Opt for commercial-grade vinyl plank flooring or tile over carpet in high-traffic areas, choose washable, semi-gloss paints for walls, and install solid surface countertops that resist stains and scratches. Select sturdy cabinetry and plumbing fixtures that can withstand tenant wear-and-tear. Discussing material options with your contractor, who understands the demands of rental properties, is key to making choices that minimize future repair costs and maintenance efforts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ensure durability by choosing robust materials like LVP flooring, washable paint, and solid surface counters, designed for high-traffic rental use.
